items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: They would have been Shakespeare, maybe.

ctx.x: It's an old black expression of the '20s, if a guy would say, 'well, how do you do?' 'Dry long so.' He was coming on down the road dry long so. Just taking his time, drinking. I haven't heard it in ages.

Well, you know, because so many black people are uneducated they would have a natural genius for language. They would have been Shakespeare, maybe. So it came out in some of these godawful expressions, the most beautiful expressions you can ever think of. In a way you almost say, I hope they never get educated because --
